claim: With the trapping laser (1064 nm) at 80% level through the 10x objective, about 1050 mW reached the sample plane on 2026-09-09 -- read above the power meter head's rated range, so an order of magnitude only.
validity_conditions: Worksheet Power row 135. Level recorded as 20 % in the worksheet; entered as 80 % on the person's ruling -- see the source's trapping_laser_rows.ruling_levels. Measured 2026-09-09 by Kyu Hwan Choi and Saksham Malik with a Thorlabs PM100A and an S121C photodiode head (the person, 2026-09-24), wavelength set to the line, every spot inside the sensor. Mirror in, multiband in, IR in. Valid to 2036-09-24. OUT OF THE HEAD'S RANGE: Thorlabs rates the S121C at 500 nW - 500 mW, and this reading is above it, so it is outside the sensor's specification. A photodiode past its range usually reads low rather than high, so the true power is more likely at or above this than below it -- but that is the usual behaviour, not a property anyone checked on this head. Entered on the person's ruling to enter all readings, at order-of-magnitude precision. WHAT THE LEVEL IS: the trapping laser's level setting as used in the measurement; trap_laser_power_has_no_software_path records that software can neither set nor read it.
